_golden: GOLDEN REFERENCE (arc sensory: food & drink, fashion & beauty, travel, hospitality, home). Study it, then write YOUR product's film from YOUR docs. Do not copy its lines, its numbers or its product. It is not buildable (no materials). Every _why says what a top crew did and why. Another sensory example, built and rendered: examples/product-demo/ (Aurel).
_facts: The docs this film was written from (fictional product): Saltwick smoked sea salt. Raked by hand from the tide pools of one bay on the Yorkshire coast. Harvested only April to September, when the sun dries the pools. Smoked over oak for 48 hours. Sold in a 120 g tin. Two people, one bay.

_anchors.proposition: A pinch of salt can carry a whole coastline.
_anchors.concept: One bay — every flake starts as a wave in the same small bay
_anchors.hook: Every flake starts as a wave.
_anchors.last: From one bay, to your table.
_anchors._why: A sensory film sells a place and a texture, not features. The concept is the origin (one bay); the hook makes it physical (a wave); the last line brings the bay to the viewer.

name: saltwick-film

brand.name: Saltwick
motto: From one bay, to your table.

scenes._why: The whole cover is a cold open: no logo, no name; the brand lands at the hero and the end card. Macro-to-place: the voice says something physical and true before we know the product.

say.en: Every flake starts as a wave.
say.zh: 每一片盐，都从一道浪开始。

scenes._why: Mood with a fact in it: the name of the place and the season. A place you can find on a map beats 'pristine nature'.

say.en: In one bay on the Yorkshire coast, the sun dries the tide pools from April to September.
say.cap: In one bay on the Yorkshire coast, the sun dries the tide pools, April to September.
say.zh: 约克郡海岸的一湾海水，四到九月，阳光晒干潮池。

scenes._why: Texture beat, short (2 bars), with one line that names what we see: a calm beat after the first line of facts, not a silent hold.
The reveal names the craft in three short verbs-and-nouns. No adjectives.

say.en: Raked by hand. Smoked over oak for forty-eight hours.
say.cap: Raked by hand. Smoked over oak for 48 hours.
say.zh: 手工耙取，橡木烟熏 48 小时。

scenes._why: In life: one plate, one pinch. The line is an instruction, not a claim, so it needs no proof.

title.en: The last thing on the plate

say.en: Add it last. A pinch is enough.

scenes._why: Hero at ~65 %: the bay from the cold open returns full-bleed (a bookend); the tagline is the concept in four words.
The callback brings the hook's place to the viewer's table: the film ends on the audience, not on the tin.

say.en: From one bay, to your table.
